sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Treasury withdrawal for the Cardano Builder DAO, described as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate capital to Cardano builders tied to ecosystem KPIs.
Recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds received and administered initially by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.

Deliverables: Fund builders whose work can improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL., Continue and expand KPI tracking, including movement toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data., Operate proposal evaluation, feedback coordination, transparent fund distribution, and result tracking for funded work., Use an independent administrator/multisig to validate milestones before Cardano Builder DAO receives funds., Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury after completion.

model_layer.note: Claim extraction and the plain-language message are model-assisted, advisory layers. The hard gates (stale data, missing evidence, treasury-needs-dossier, hard blockers, high flags) are deterministic and binding. The doctrine-aware reasoning layer records a bounded advisory lean of at most ±0.05, but it is not added to the binding score and cannot change the vote.
